notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows the arm9/dCc_c and arm9/Clipper entries, which took the same route.

dCcAc_c is the cylinder collision primitive attached to an dActor_c: Init fixes radius/height/flags on the dCc_c base and stores the owner back-pointer; both virtuals read through owner (GetPos returns the owner's dActor_c+0x5c position, GetOwnerID returns owner->uniqueID at +4).

The whole class folds, lifecycle variants included: the cartridge's D2,D0,D1,C1,C2 order is the order one ~dCcAc_c() plus one dCcAc_c() emits under deferred codegen (same shape as the neighbouring arm9/dCc_c fold), so no per-variant shards remain. D0 ends in the class's inline operator delete, which routes to Memory::operator_delete2 per include/dCcAc_c.h.

Init stays a mangled extern "C" definition (wall 6az, notes/mwccarm-codegen.md): the Fix12<int> by-value parameters keep the free spelling while dCcAc_c.h's member declaration stays the real signature callers use.
The file is written ROM-descending because mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order under default deferred codegen; the emitted object carries the eight functions ascending 0x0201490c..0x02014a20.
